Details: The test `testGenerateURLFragment` checks whether HTML entities such as `"` are correctly escaped to their corresponding character by the `StandardToolTipTagFragmentGenerator.generateToolTipFragment` method. Consequently, un-escaped strings are being returned, which leads to the error demonstrated by the test.

```java
488 :     @Test

490 :         final StringWriter sw = new StringWriter();
491 :         final CSVPrinter printer = new CSVPrinter(sw, CSVFormat.DEFAULT.withQuoteChar(null)
492 :                 .withHeader("C1", "C2", "C3"));
493 :         printer.printRecord("a", "b", "c");
494 :         printer.printRecord("x", "y", "z");
495 :         assertEquals("C1,C2,C3\r\na,b,c\r\nx,y,z\r\n", sw.toString()); // error occurred here
497 :     }
```

```

x,y,z

x,y,z

	at org.apache.commons.csv.CSVPrinterTest.testHeader(CSVPrinterTest.java:495)
```
